sentences.text: National Insurance Company Limited vs Mounjera Khatun & Ors

on 10 June, 2025
10.06.2025
Dl-47
Ct. No. 33
Srimanta

In the High Court at Calcutta
 Civil Appellate Jurisdiction
 Appellate Side
 Ia No.: Can/1/2023, Can/2/2025
 in
 Fmat(Mv) 719 of 2023
 National Insurance Company Limited
 -Vs.-
 Mounjera Khatun & Ors.

Mr. Rajesh Singh
 ...for the appellant/Insurance Company.

Mr. Ali Imam Shah
 ...for the respondents/claimants.

Re: Can 2 of 2025 The learned advocates for the appellant/Insurance Company as well as
respondent No.1/claimants are present.
The application being CAN 2 of 2025 under Section 5 of the limitation Act has been taken up for hearing.
From the record it reveals that there is a delay of 23 days.

Considering the averments made in paragraph nos. 3, 4 and 5 of the CAN application being 2 of 2025 and in view of the beneficial legislative intent the delay of 23 days in filing the instant case is condoned.
The application being CAN 2 of 2025 is allowed.
The Department is directed to register the appeal.
In Re: CAN 1 of 2023

As per the order of this Court dated 17.01.2024 the Insurance Company had deposited the entire awarded compensation before the office of the learned Registrar General, High Court at Calcutta vide OD Challan No. 3646 dated 01.02.2024.
Let the said challan be kept on record.
Accordingly, the interim order of stay dated 17.01.2024 is made absolute and the stay shall continue till the disposal of the instant appeal.
